summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Come In marketplace upgrade (auth, shops, products, orders, requests, uploads, admin). Fixed one critical React hooks-order bug on /become-seller. Backend 23/23 pytest cases pass. Core frontend flows (auth, admin approval, shop creation, request-anything, shops list, shop detail actions, language) verified end-to-end via Playwright. One UI gap on cart stepper discoverability.

ui_bugs.issue: React error: 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render.' due to useRef() being called AFTER early-return guards for !user and loading. Caused the whole seller onboarding to crash to the error-fallback screen immediately after shop fetch finished. FIXED by hoisting useRef above the early returns (hooks must be top-level and unconditional).

After tapping assist-submit the modal appears to close without visibly showing the generated AG-xxxxxx reference in the UI (backend creates the row correctly and admin tab shows it). Consider adding a visible success toast/screen like Request-Anything's modal.

Quantity stepper only exposes a parent testid stepper-{productId}; the inner + and − controls have no individual testids, making UI-driven add-to-cart hard to automate and may hurt accessibility. Suggest adding stepper-{id}-plus / stepper-{id}-minus / stepper-{id}-value.

ui_bugs.component: /shops row for newly approved DB shop
ui_bugs.issue: Area/address line renders empty for shops where only `address` is set (no `area`). The row shows ' · Closed' with a leading dot. Fallback to address or hide the separator when area is blank.

issues: Place order button stays disabled-styled (light green) when cart is empty but 'Place order · ₹0' text is still readable — add a non-destructive hint 'Your cart is empty' when total is 0 to avoid user confusion.

action_items: Consider surfacing an on-screen confirmation (toast or modal) with the AG- reference after agent-assist submit in /shop/[id].tsx (parity with request-anything).
Add granular testids to Stepper (plus/minus/value) to enable UI add-to-cart automation and improve a11y.
On /shops, when a shop has no area, render address or omit the separator so rows don't display a stray ' · Closed'.
Optionally gray-out and label the Place-order button when cart total is 0.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: public GET /api/shops correctly filters status=approved. Pending shops do NOT leak — verified by test.
server.py: /shops/{id}/availability correctly rejects online toggle until status=='approved' (400 response).
server.py: orders stock decrement happens server-side using ObjectId validation — guest and authed orders both work.
server.py: doc_out strips _id and password_hash — good. BUT /auth/me and /uploads/image responses expose full user doc including the mongo-created phone/email fine.
server.py @app.on_event('startup')/('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context manager when convenient.
become-seller.tsx had hooks-order bug (now fixed). Keep ALL hooks (useState/useRef/useEffect) above every early return.
Frontend /checkout proceeds with 0 items only because UI disables the button — backend already rejects empty items (422). Good defense in depth.
updated_files: /app/frontend/app/become-seller.tsx (hoisted useRef above early returns to fix hooks error)

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all core flows verified; stepper add-to-cart UI not driven via automation)

test_credentials: Admin admin@comein.app / ComeIn@2026Admin confirmed working. Customer test accounts created on the fly via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_* customers, 2 TEST_* shops (one approved via admin flow), 1 TEST_* product, 2 TEST_* orders, 1 TEST_* request-anything, 1 TEST_* agent-assist. All visible under admin tabs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Admin seed is idempotent. Approved live shop IDs (from this run) show up at the top of /shops before the seed shops. The become-seller hooks fix is the only code change; main agent should verify no regressions on shop edit flow (loading existing shop and submitting PATCH).
rca of the issue: React 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' thrown by /become-seller when the shop fetch resolved and `loading` flipped true→false. First render skipped useRef (returned early at `if (loading)` branch), second render executed it, violating the Rules of Hooks. Fix: move `useRef` to run before any conditional/early return. All useState/useEffect are already above the guards; useRef must follow the same ordering.
